notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer - A smaller update, but with big anticipated changes!
notes.notes:
Hey aimers! Big news in the latest 3D Aim Trainer update – let's jump into what's new:

1. Improved Training Info: Boost Your Game!

Check out the new training info view, loaded with insights to up your game. You'll find tips and tricks on tactics, best practices, detailed gun info, and recommended levels for honing specific skills. It's your go-to resource for improving each aspect of your aiming ability. Ready to level up?

2. Dashboard Customization: Make It Yours!

Ever wanted to personalize your gaming identity? Now you can with customizable nicknames right on your dashboard page! This new feature lets you tailor your gaming persona to match your style. Get creative and stand out in the 3D Aim Trainer community!

-----

Excited to see you in action with these fresh updates! 🎯🌟

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer Update Notes - New Quick Play Levels!
notes.notes:
Patch Highlights
🔶 14 New Quick Play Levels
🔶 Beginner Friendly Rookie Range
🔶 New Survival Mode Levels
🔶 Android Apocalypse
🔶 Updated Flicking, Clicking & Tracking Become a Pro environments
🔶 New Quick Play and Become a Pro statistics

Patch Details
🔶 The Quick Play Page needed some love and so that's what we gave it. We used what we learned from the academy and upgraded the quick play levels. Fourteen brand new levels for you to enjoy. Have fun!

🔶 For something completely new, we added a Rookie Range level for new players out there to understand the very basics of aim training and what it's for.

🔶 We added a new type of level called Survival Modes. Here you will be able to play for as long as you can hold on. The better you get, the further you'll make it. Each of these levels will get harder over time so you'll really feel yourself improving as you go on longer and longer runs. Let's go!

🔶 We replaced the old zombie survival level and in it's place we present Android Apocalypse. Good luck staying alive and show these droids what you're made of.

🔶 You will find that we retrofitted new environments in the old Become a Pro levels. Find these changes on the Become a Pro page for the flicking, clicking and tracking levels. Enjoy!

🔶 We overhauled on how statistics work for the Quick Play and Become a Pro levels. This way your leaderboard rank will much more accurately represent your actual skills compared to everyone else. Time to start competing!

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - Tracking Academy 2.0
notes.notes:
We have updated and overhauled the Tracking Academy completely 🔥. This is the third Academy Update out of four. Tracking Academy 2.0 features 73 new training levels with some awesome new training mechanics specially designed for tracking!
---
Update Highlights

 New Precision Tracking Subskill
 New Smoothness Tracking Subskill
 New Speed Tracking Subskill
 New Reactivity Tracking Subskill

---
[previewyoutube=S5dqK9tVD1w;full][/previewyoutube]
---
Details

New Precision Tracking Subskill: Precision tracking is mostly about improving your ability to track long dodging targets. More predictable move patterns will make it easier for you to focus on your precision.

New Smoothness Tracking Subskill: This subskill is about combatting mouse stutter. Targets move in easy to read patterns and focusing on smooth tracking is the key to success.

New Speed Tracking Subskill: Speed is about learning how to track fast moving targets. This will really bump your accuracy once you return to easier to read, slow targets.

New Reactivity Tracking Subskill: Reactivity is all about your ability to adjust aim on moving targets. Their move patterns are erratic and hard to read, so how fast you can react and adjust is what's being improved here.

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - Clicking Academy 2.0
notes.notes:
We have updated and overhauled the Clicking Academy completely. 🔥
Clicking Academy 2.0 features 57 new training levels with some awesome new training arena's and new training mechanics!
---
Update Highlights


 New Verified Clicking Subskill
 New Point Clicking Subskill
 New Efficiency Clicking Subskill
 New Reactive Clicking Subskill

---
[previewyoutube=h6ldKFDfqno;full][/previewyoutube]
---
Details

New Verified Clicking Subskill: This subskill is all about target verification. That means that the levels are designed to teach you that you should first confirm your crosshair on the target before you pull the trigger. These levels have accuracy correction, so your score gets reduced if you miss and on top of that your weapons have a reduced rate of fire.

New Point Clicking Subskill: Point clicking is the art of going fast. No accuracy correction here and no reduced fire rate. Your score depends heavily on the amount of targets you are able to shoot within the time limit. For this reason, the targets are often bigger, but they move faster as well. That means you can shoot more on intuition.

New Efficiency Clicking Subskill: This subskill is about pathing. That means that you are training yourself how to be efficient at shooting multiple targets. These levels have a bunch of new mechanics ready to be explored.

New Reactive Clicking Subskill: Reactive clicking trains your reflexes and thus reaction speed. The big difference with point clicking is that the targets will move reactively to your actions, creating a training environment ideal for upping your reflexes.
---

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - Flicking Academy 2.0
notes.notes:
We have updated and overhauled the Flicking Academy completely with new levels, visuals, weapons and sounds 🔥. This is the first in a series of updates where we will tackle and update the entire academy!
---
Update Highlights


Updated visuals and sounds on weapons
New training environments
Flicking academy overhaul - Speed, Accuracy
Flicking academy overhaul - Difficulty tiers
Flicking academy overhaul - Statistics

---
[previewyoutube=zOAEUfl39IQ;full][/previewyoutube]
---
Details:

Updated visuals and sounds on weapons: We overhauled all the weapon models to make them more fitting with our highly detailed environments, giving them a cool and fresh new look. We also added new sound effects or updated existing ones to go along with it.

New training environments: There are a total of 7 new training environments to be played in the updated flicking academy. This with a total of 33 new training levels to be explored.

Flicking academy overhaul - Speed, Accuracy: The flicking academy is now divided in two main departments: Speed & Accuracy. Each with their own characteristics, levels and scoring system. We feel that this is a mandatory split as they are two sections to be mastered individually.

Flicking academy overhaul - Difficulty tiers: Both the Speed and Accuracy sections are layered with three different difficulty tiers: Basic, Intermediate and Advanced. These provide a much bigger challenge to the particular aiming sub-skills in question.

Flicking academy overhaul - Statistics: We've added a whole bunch of new statistics you can track and monitor. Things like TTK, kill-ratio, crit accuracy, time2target, reaction speed, ... This will make it a lot easier and more detailed to view your progress over time in a variety of interesting ways.
---

---

Update Highlights

 Unboarding tasks added
 Dashboard page updated
 Notifications for completing unboarding tasks


---

Details:

Unboarding tasks added: New players will get a set of tasks they can perform that help them navigate through the platform and get acquainted with the different sections the platform has to offer.

Dashboard page updated: The dashboard page has been updated to fit all the unboarding tasks in an easy to use manner. A button labeled "tasks" is made available to do this.

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - January 13, 2022
notes.notes:
The "Become A Pro" section has been added to the game and combines the assessment and academy in an easy to use overview that allows you to monitor and practice more efficiently.
---
[previewyoutube=WCjtjSHXp6s;full][/previewyoutube]
---

Update Highlights

 Added "Become A Pro" section
 Assessment overview tree
 Play assessment levels separately
 Easy overview of academy levels


---

Details:

Added "Become A Pro" section: The old assessment and academy have been combined in one section called "Become A Pro". Here you can easily track and monitor which sub-skills you need to improve on and where you rank.

Assessment overview tree: When you click the "Become A Pro" section, you will see the assessment overview tree. This gives you the ability to easily see all the different sub-skills, each of their separate levels and how each of them add to your Global Aim Rank.

Play assessment levels separately: You can now play each of the assessment levels by themselves without having to go through all the sub-skills. This makes it a lot easier to assess one part of your aim skill.

Easy overview of academy levels: Because of the new UI and "Become A Pro" section, it's now much more straightforward to see what academy levels work for which assessment gamemodes. This way you can easily practice and re-assess the skills you need to focus on.

---

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - September 29, 2021
notes.notes:
A new update for your 3DAT Steam version is arriving today. We made some crucial bug fixes and added some cool new stuff for you to enjoy.
---

Update Highlights


 Added restart functionality
 New in-game HUD
 New in-game Menu
 Reworked environments (check details)
 Bug Fixes


---

Details:

Added restart functionality: Players now have the option to restart a training level by pressing 'escape' and select 'restart' from the menu.

New in-game HUD: We overhauled the HUD so it's easier to read while playing. It now also has a visual effect when you are getting low on bullets or when time is running out, making it easier to identify even without paying attention to it.

New in-game Menu: Once you're in a training level you can go to the menu by pressing 'escape'. Here we added some new features along with making everything easier to navigate through.

Reworked environments: On the Tile Frenzy, Sphere Clash, Iron Ball and Go Figure training levels we updated the environments to boost visual recognition. We also just made it look very cool!

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where Assessment related percentiles and values were shown as 'NaN'.
 Fixed a bug on Flicking levels where the hit and kill sounds seemed not set on the volume slider.
 Fixed a bug where on sometimes the default resolution got messed up and black bars were shown.
 Fixed a bug where the player and the target angle spawn location was out of sync. This on Eagle's Nest.
 Fixed a bug on Burst Flick where new targets would spawn before the previous ones were shot.


---

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - September 23, 2021
notes.notes:
A new update for your 3DAT Steam version is arriving today, and we added some handy features that will make the game feel more intuitive. We also fixed some bugs and added some extra guidance for newer players.
---

Update Highlights


 Landing page
 Onboarding tutorials
 Intuitive Academy progression
 Enhanced level-loading mechanism
 More accurate Assessment percentiles
 Bug Fixes

---

Details:

Landing Page: We created a new landing page for when you open the Steam app. Here you get a quick overview of all the most common options, along with showing your Global Aim Rank. This landing page will allow us to add more nifty and cool features in the future.

Onboarding Tutorials: When you open the Assessment, Academy or Quick Play menu's for the first time, you will receive a short instructional guide on how everything works and why you should use. This will guide newer players to the tools they need.

Intuitive Academy Progression: The academy is about progressing through difficulty levels in order to find your threshold and reach higher plateaus. We saw that some users skipped a lot of levels only to underperform on greater difficulties. This fixes this issue.

Enhanced Level-Loading Mechanism: We reworked the manner and upgraded the efficiency of how the game loads levels. This should now be an even smoother and faster endeavour.

More Accurate Assessment Percentiles: Your Assessment scores are now being calculated more precise, giving you more detailed statistics when evaluating your gameplay and progress over time.
---
